annotations.title: Insider trades (Form 4) for a company or insider

description: Recent SEC Form 4 insider transactions for one company (ticker or issuer CIK) or one insider (reporting-owner CIK). Returns a summary (open-market buy/sell counts, shares, dollar value, distinct insiders) and one row per transaction: date, insider, role, transaction code (P=open-market buy, S=sale, A=award, M=option exercise, F=tax withholding, G=gift), shares, price, value, shares owned after, 10b5-1 flag and filing link. Use side="buy" to see only open-market purchases.

codes.description: Only these transaction codes, e.g. ["P","S"] or ["M","F"].

filings.description: How many of the most recent Form 4 filings to parse (each costs one SEC request). Default 5.

max_rows.description: Maximum transaction rows to return. Default 25.

side.description: Only open-market purchases (buy, code P) or sales (sell, code S).

since.description: Only filings on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

ticker_or_cik.description: Stock ticker (e.g. "AAPL", "BRK.B") or SEC CIK number (e.g. "320193").

name: get_insider_trades
